main_screen.meaning: Predeclared provisional screen; angle_only is an ablation, not an outcome-selected replacement.

limits: Window observations include endpoints; held-command metrics exclude upper endpoint and the terminal observation.
Demand belt-A maximum uses ALL6.6–6.9s samples, without selecting true-loaded contacts afterward.
Raw reference means the unchanged formula evaluated from each arm current observer, not common future quaternion replay.
Generator replay is pure saved-input ODE arithmetic; no robot/contact physics. Coordinate acceleration bounds are not transported-body component acceleration limits.
One execution per arm, simulation-state measurement surrogate; no stability/hardware/robustness or default-promotion claim.
